bio_techne.origin: Core notional, tenor, date, rates, DV01 and outcome probabilities supplied by assignment. Credit DV01 equality, premiums and delay costs added as synthetic sensitivities; not tradable quotes.

validation_template.origin: Every numerical financing/market parameter is synthetic. A 1bn local-currency, seven-year fixed-rate refinancing slice allows comparable risk sensitivities; it is not disclosed debt issuance or the full bridge. Dates and probabilities are scenario inputs, not forecasts.

cross_currency_template.origin: Synthetic 25% USD-funded share of EUR refinancing slice, FX spot/shock, 50% bridge utilization, EURIBOR, margin and step-up size. Disclosed rating grids and fees must be separately reviewed; these assumptions are not extracted pricing.
